svg.aria-label: Constructed four-panel diagnostics: steady line and lag, fit-start sensitivity, thickness series and finite-volume effects. Panel D is a separate two-compartment model neglecting membrane storage to illustrate changing external driving force; A–C retain the fixed-boundary planar-membrane transient.
